title: Sandisolar SD 11KP48V WIFI Grid Power correlation
summary: For the exact layout-4/model-0x8003 Sandisolar fingerprint, manufacturer-cloud screenshots and the inverter display showed non-zero Grid Power while the inherited register-204 projection remained zero in Home Assistant. This is supporting evidence that register 204 is not a usable canonical Grid Power source for this layout; the primary register-340 mapping comes from the protocol-4 documentation rather than from a same-instant raw correlation.
